projects.title: SuperSort
projects.goal: Search for genuinely new, architecture-aware mechanisms that make practically relevant sorting tasks substantially faster than the best existing implementations.

latest.title: Reusing packed rank groups across sliding windows
latest.summary: Keeping already packed indices between adjacent windows was slower than packing them again, even though only one or two groups changed. The fastest cached variant ran at 0.647–0.950× the speed of the best reference on the main inputs.
latest.result: 0.647–0.950× on primary inputs across two passes
